designLog.details: Created Φ (FOCUS): Current locus of directed attention / spotlight of processing.
Created τ (TICK): One internal clock-cycle / neural tick used to advance simulation time.
Created σ (SPIKE): Discrete neural spike / event on spike-bus.
Created R (READ): Memory retrieval operation (semantic, episodic, vector, etc.).
Created W (WRITE): Memory write / store operation.
Created C (CONSOLIDATE): Memory consolidation / compression pass.
Created α (AGENT): A single autonomous sub-agent within the mesh.
Created T (TASK): Unit of work / goal-directed procedure.
Created G (GOAL): Desired outcome or high-level objective in goal-system.
Created E (EMO): Emotional state vector / affective signal.
Created μ (MU): Compute/energy resource token (micro-resource unit).
Created Ω (WORLD): Snapshot or stream from the unified world model / sensors.
Created S (SAFE): Security / safety constraint check flag.
Created Δ (DELTA): Change proposal or evolutionary diff for self-modification.
Created Π (PREDICT): Predicted future state / output of predictive processor.
Created Λ (LANG): Language representation / prompt token in language-center.
Created M (MODEL): Internal micro-transformer / sub-model invocation handle.
Created K (KNOW): Knowledge-graph node or assertion triple.
Created B (BOUND): Boundary bridge between internal SCL and external text/data.
Created Ø (NULL): Explicit empty / absent value or no-op.
Created rule: R+T → Retrieve context for a task
Created rule: α+T → Agent assigned to task
Created rule: Φ+E → Emotion-weighted attention
Created rule: Δ+M → Model self-modification
Created rule: S+Λ → Safety-filtered language output
Created instruction: READ_MEM → R.op(key)
Created instruction: WRITE_MEM → W.op(key,data)
Created instruction: CONSOLIDATE_MEM → C.run()
Created instruction: ASSIGN_TASK → α(id).T(assign)
Created instruction: PREDICT_STATE → Π(Ω, horizon)

These 20 primitives were distilled by scanning function names, class names, and comments across 602 internal files. The most recurrent core concepts are attention (focus/Φ), time-step ticks (τ), neural spikes/events (σ), memory operations (R/W/C), agent & task orchestration (α/T/G), emotional modulation (E), compute resources (μ), world/sensory state (Ω), security and safety checks (S), self-evolution deltas (Δ), predictive processing (Π), language handling (Λ), model invocation (M), knowledge graph access (K), and boundary translation (B). A NULL token (Ø) appears often in code as a sentinel. The chosen symbols are single-character, many leveraging Greek letters already familiar in the code (e.g., Φ, Π, Δ) to minimize cognitive load. Composition rules mirror frequent two-token pairings observed (e.g., R+T, α+T). Initial instruction mappings connect SCL directly to existing TypeScript API calls, ensuring the language can immediately express common internal operations while remaining extremely compact.
